canonical_statement: For every positive natural degree n and real coefficient vector (a_0,...,a_n) with a_0 > 0, the polynomial a_0 z^n + a_1 z^(n-1) + ... + a_n has every complex root in the strict open left half-plane if and only if all n leading principal minors of its finite Hurwitz matrix are positive.

source_selection.citation: Yury S. Barkovsky, Lectures on the Routh-Hurwitz problem, arXiv:0802.1805v1 (2008)
source_selection.definition_locator: printed page 6 defines a stable polynomial by all roots lying in the open left half-plane
source_selection.matrix_locator: section 6, printed page 18, equation (34), defines the n by n finite Hurwitz matrix and zero extension
source_selection.relationship_to_primary_source: Hurwitz 1895 pages 273-274 states the same positive-leading-coefficient determinant criterion under historical notation; the intake-observed PDF SHA-256 is e625ad366a91e771ce45319fbaae53959dd35a1ed384b95e4a4046cfda99fbad.
source_selection.review_boundary: The checked statement follows the pinpointed modern source passage and the primary-source intake cross-check. Full proof translation, correction and errata audit, independent H0 review, and master acceptance remain downstream/open; no H0 promotion is proposed.

domain_and_universes: All carriers are in universe 0: n : Nat; a : Fin (n+1) -> Real; the real coefficient vector is embedded into Polynomial Complex; Hurwitz matrices use Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Real.
conclusion: IsStrictlyStable a iff every source minor eta_(k+1), k : Fin n, is strictly positive.

encoding_decisions.coefficient_order: a j is the descending source coefficient of z^(n-j); Polynomial.ofFn is fed j |-> a (n-j) to obtain Lean's ascending coefficient order
encoding_decisions.degree: n is positive and the coefficient vector has exactly n+1 entries; a_0 > 0 prevents degree drop
encoding_decisions.complex_roots: the real polynomial is mapped through Complex.ofRealHom; IsRoot is used without enumerating multiplicities because the criterion universally constrains root values
encoding_decisions.strict_stability: forall z, IsRoot (p.map Complex.ofRealHom) z -> z.re < 0
encoding_decisions.hurwitz_entries: zero-based entry (i,j) is a_(2*j+1-i) when i <= 2*j+1, with source coefficients outside 0..n zero-extended
encoding_decisions.minor_index: k : Fin n denotes the source minor eta_(k+1), computed on the first k+1 rows and columns via Fin.castLE
encoding_decisions.boundary: n=0 is excluded as the positive-degree statement selected from the source's n by n matrix and k=1,...,n criterion; imaginary-axis roots, zero minors, nonpositive leading coefficient, degree drop, complex coefficients, and nonnegative-minor variants are excluded
